mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, causing a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which signals an impending economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening labor market that reduces recession risk and boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1.2 million units annually, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1200.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate signals a shift toward monetary easing that reduces the risk of a recession and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
